category_title: Students with high online continuity and regular LMS engagement
minimal_context: The student is writing a post about their weekend plans on the online discussion board and replying to peers.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please post a few lines describing your plans for the weekend on the discussion board, and then respond to two of your peers.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Okay, I posted my sentences: 'I will go to the park this weekend. I will play soccer.'

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Can you write a bit more about that?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know many words yet. I will just add: 'I like the park. It is good.'

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please make sure to reply to your classmates' posts now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I replied to John. I just wrote 'Me too, I have the same plans.' I don't know how to say anything else to start a real discussion.
